reviews.text: Ok, so I got this app because I wanted my phone to be cooler and like “modern” I guess. But nothing works?!? Ok yes I have an iPhone 10 but nothing works. I can’t use a charging animation, none of the live wallpapers, none of the widgets cause you have to pay like 30 dollars to use them, and I can’t use app icons either. If the creators are seeing this, I really recommend making less stuff with subscription. As I see from other reviews, no one liked the idea of mostly everything having to subscribe for. At this point just make the app a like $40 purchase on the App Store so people who want full access for free don’t purchase this app, but if you creators don’t want that I recommend giving more content for free. I hope this helps.

reviews.title: Looks good but…
reviews.text: It’s not a bad visually looking app. But one thing I thought I like, is that if I select install theme then I want you to install the entire theme. I don’t want to have to go behind the app and manually install my wallpapers, my lock screen wallpapers, and each app, along with any charging screen animation. I’m sorry, but that is just too much work. I would rate it higher if I could just select “install theme” and the app does all the work. You have to manually install everything yourself. At that point, what am I paying $30 for? I can manually google some of these same wallpapers off of google and “manually” install myself.
